nodes.label: typecheck (dev) workflow
nodes.rationale: The gate for tsconfig.dev.json - the only configuration that compiles tests/, examples/ and benchmarks/ alongside src/ (#540). timeout-minutes: 15 over a sub-minute tsc turns a pathological compile into a red job rather than a stalled queue slot.

nodes.label: Caller-side defect class
nodes.rationale: bun test transpiles without type-checking and bun run typecheck uses the build tsconfig, which excludes all three trees, so an entire class of defect was invisible: an exported class narrower than the interface it implements (NoopLogger, NoopMetricsRegistry, HashAllocationStrategy.allocate), an exported type nothing could satisfy (OtelContextLike), a documented call shape that never compiled (SchemaRegistry.eventAdapter into PersistentActor). All of it compiled for the library and broke only for a caller, which is what tests/ and examples/ are. It also stops the count re-inflating: the burn-down cleared 321 diagnostics and two had arrived days earlier from adoption sweeps that missed an example.

nodes.label: Own workflow, not a step in test.yml
nodes.rationale: Path filters are per-workflow, not per-job: test.yml triggers on src/** and tests/** only, so a step added there would never fire on an examples/** or benchmarks/** change - the very changes this configuration exists to cover - while widening test.yml's filters would run the full ~4-minute suite plus the coverage gate on every example edit. And it is cheap: one tsc --noEmit over the whole tree, seconds after the install, so it can be a required check without slowing anything.
